[[Bei Chi's Bulwark]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by [[Imperial Guard Lockbox]]es.

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Command]])
:Reduces [[Blind]] duration on you by 20%
:Health +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Goldleaf Defender]].

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Goldleaf Defender]] from collectors [[Cait]] or [[Dagnor Grubeater]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|I Can See Clearly Now]]" inscription

**[[Imperial Shield]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Shield]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|I Can See Clearly Now]]" inscription
OR
